facts.statement: Acuetzpalin is an extinct genus of ophthalmosaurid ichthyosaur whose name means "water lizard" in Classical Nahuatl.
facts.quote: Acuetzpalin (meaning "water lizard" in Classical Nahuatl) is an extinct genus of platypterygiine ophthalmosaurid ichthyosaur found in the Kimmeridgian La Casita Formation in Mexico.

facts.statement: The known fossil material consists of a partial skeleton that lacks limbs but features a surprisingly well-preserved skull.
facts.quote: It is known from a partial skeleton (missing the limbs), of which the skull is surprisingly well preserved.

facts.statement: Scientists estimate the animal was more than 3.1 meters long when accounting for the missing parts of the holotype.
facts.quote: Its length is estimated to have been more than 3.1 m long, considering the missing parts of the holotype.

facts.statement: The species Acuetzpalin carranzai was discovered in limestone of the La Casita Formation at Cerro de Palotes, near Cuencamé, Durango, Mexico.
facts.quote: Acuetzpalin carranzai es la única especie conocida del género extinto Acuetzpalin, un ictiosaurio oftalmosaurio platipterígiino que fue descubierto en las calizas de la Formación La Casita en la localidad del Cerro de Palotes, cercana a Cuencamé, Durango, México.

facts.statement: A 2020 phylogenetic analysis places Acuetzpalin within the subfamily Platypterygiinae among the most derived members of that group.
facts.quote: A phylogenetic analysis conducted in 2020 reveals that Acuetzpalin is a member of the subfamily Platypterygiinae and is located among the most-derived platypterygiines.

facts.statement: Acuetzpalin is classified as a reptile in the order Ichthyosauria, suborder Neoichthyosauria, infraorder Thunnosauria, and family Ophthalmosauridae.
facts.quote: regnum: Animalia phylum: Chordata classis: Sauropsida superordo: Ichthyopterygia ordo: Ichthyosauria subordo: Neoichthyosauria infraordo: Thunnosauria familia: Ophthalmosauridae subfamilia: Platypterygiinae

facts.statement: Fossils of Acuetzpalin come from the Kimmeridgian stage of the Late Jurassic period.
facts.quote: found in the Kimmeridgian La Casita Formation in Mexico.

facts.statement: Acuetzpalin lived between 154.8 and 149.2 million years ago during the Kimmeridgian stage.
facts.quote: Time range: Kimmeridgian to Kimmeridgian (154.8 to 149.2 million years ago)
